Is this safe to use?

Your file is opened by the page itself.

It is read on your own computer, by the page you have open. It is not sent anywhere, so a patient study or a signed contract stays where it already is.

The web tools: nothing to install, no account.

Open the link and start. There is no sign-up, no e-mail to hand over and no trial that ends. The few you install, such as Carino DICOM and Carino Setup, say so on their own page.

Free, and open to read.

Every tool here is free to use, and the code behind it is public — anyone who knows how can check what it does.

Most of it keeps working with the cable out.

The work happens in the page, so once it has loaded, a dropped line does not stop it. The few that read live data say so on their own page.

The same on a phone, a tablet or a computer.

There is one version and it is this one. Nothing to keep updated, and nothing that only works on the machine you were not carrying.

Named in plain words, and by its real name.

Every tool is written down twice — what it does, and what it is called — so you never have to already know the word to find the thing.

Would you like a hand?

If you would like one of these set up properly for your clinic or office — or something built for the way you actually work — write to me and we will talk it through.
